Indian Institutions Sign MoUs for Research and Academic Collaboration

Multiple Indian educational institutions have recently signed Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) to foster research, innovation, and academic collaboration. The University of North Bengal (NBU) has partnered with a Japanese university for chemical research, aiming to enhance global academic ties. Additionally, BIT Mesra and IIT Kharagpur have signed an MoU to advance their research and innovation efforts. Separately, an MoU has been signed specifically for semiconductor research, indicating a focus on key technological areas.
